intent: Dark, monochrome plan-comparison table: plan headers stagger in with counting prices, rows rise group by group as checks draw, and the recommended column is lifted with one accent edge. Becomes a plan switcher on phones.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants with custom delays, useInView, useMotionValue, useTransform, useVelocity, animate, AnimatePresence, LayoutGroup)

layout.header: eyebrow, headline (max 18ch), body; mobile controls under it
layout.desktop: @3xl+: real table, first column 28% (30% @5xl), 4 plan columns, sticky thead, recommended band continuous from head to foot with rounded top/bottom
layout.groups: tbody per group: a row-spanning toggle row, then feature rows
layout.mobile: <@3xl: sticky tablist; full-width name/recommendation, price beside CTA, complete unit below; only the selected plan's feature column is visible
layout.stickyInset: Both sticky headers inherit --cm-sticky-top, defaulting to 0px, so a composed page can clear its navigation.

color.accent: #2dd4bf via the accent prop: 2px top edge of the recommended column and the RECOMMENDED dot (and the phone tab dot). Nothing else.
color.checks: ink in the recommended column, ink/75 elsewhere; dashes ink/30
color.ctas: recommended solid ink; others ink/4% with an ink/14% inset ring

motion.timeline: T (s): eyebrow 0, title 0.05, body 0.1, plan headers 0.16 + 0.06 each (price +0.06, CTA +0.12), accent edge 0.5, rows 0.42 + 0.12 per group, 30ms per row
motion.reveal: rise 10px from blur(8px), 500ms, ease [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]; filter dropped at rest
motion.prices: motion value counts 0→price over 600ms with a velocity blur; tweens 450ms between plans on mobile
motion.rows: each tbody has its own in-view trigger; its slot is measured from the moment the section was revealed, so on-screen groups keep timeline order and later ones start at once; rows rise 6px from blur(6px) 400ms
motion.marks: checks draw pathLength 320ms, dashes scaleX, 80ms after the row + 30ms per column; they own their state so a swapped-in mark still draws
motion.expand: rows replay the stagger; collapse fades in 120ms
motion.mobileSwitch: layoutId thumb spring 500/40; values swap with 4px rise + 3px blur, 250ms
motion.reducedMotion: one 150ms fade, prices set instantly, no transforms or blur

responsive.<@3xl: sticky plan switcher; two visible columns per row; no horizontal scroll

accessibility: table with caption and th scopes (col, row, colgroup)
group toggles with aria-expanded and aria-controls
tooltips on hover, focus and tap; Escape closes
mobile tablist with roving tabindex and arrow keys; aria-live on the selected plan summary
sr-only Included / Not included; counted prices keep the real price as sr-only text
Secondary text uses at least 65% ink opacity on these surfaces; quiet typography must remain readable in both themes.
Coarse-pointer plan links, global group controls and feature hints retain 44px targets.
Disable the global expand/collapse action when there are no feature rows.
avoid: teal or slate tints, washed recommended columns, coloured checks
more than one accent use beyond the edge and the dot
per-frame React state for counting prices
rows that pop in without the staggered blur rise
